bibliographic.title: Thank You For Your Inquiry
bibliographic.author: Louphole
bibliographic.description:
"Welcome to Simplicity Transportation Customer Service.

Thank you for taking the time to contact us about your concern. Please create a new claim so that we can deal with your enquiry quickly. We promise, it will be short and simple."

Thank You For Your Inquiry is an interactive fiction game made with Twine where you try to get a compensation from a company after a bad experience.

This game is totally not inspired by real events with a real customer service. I swear. It has nothing to do with all the email exchanges I had with a real company that drove me almost mad.

The game features 5 different money offers and 7 other endings. Of course, there's a really good ending, if you can reach it.
